people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
translations.bsb: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
translations.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
translations.asv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in the spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
